Off-Campus (Series)

Plot:

Based on the viral book series by Elle Kennedy, the show is set at Briar University and follows the lives of the elite college ice hockey team. Season 1, titled The Deal, focuses on Hannah Wells, a music major who is seemingly the only girl on campus not interested in the hockey team. When star captain Garrett Graham needs to pass a philosophy class to keep his spot on the team, he strikes a deal with Hannah: she tutors him, and he helps her win over her crush by pretending to date her.

As their fake relationship plays out in the public eye, the lines between their agreement and reality begin to blur, forcing both to contront their past traumas and true feelings.

Casting:
[Ella Bright, Belmont Cameli, Josh Heuston, Mika Abdalla, Khobe Clarke, Antonio Cipriano, Jalen Thomas Brooks, Steve Howey]

Crew:

Showrunners: Louisa Levy, Gina Fattore

Writers: Louisa Levy, Gina Fattore (Based on the novels by Elle Kennedy)

Executive Producers: Jenny Han, Hope Hartman, Mads

Hansen, Karen Rosenfelt

Production: Amazon MGM Studios

Trivia:

The series follows the "interconnected standalone" format of the books, much like Bridgerton, where each season focuses on a different couple while keeping the core friend group as recurring characters.

Belmont Cameli, who plays Garrett, actually has a background in sports, which helped him prepare for the physically demanding ice hockey sequences.

Author Elle Kennedy served as a consultant on the show to ensure the "Briar University" atmosphere-from the specific hockey house vibes to the witty banter-stayed true to the source material that built a massive following on "BookTok."
